versioned_provenance_replay.note: Same-source replay is typed-equal on a second run, so the replay function is deterministic. The release contains a single (strategy, data, model) version triple, so cross-version discrimination requires multi-version snapshots (future work).

ranking_auditability_boundary.note: Within a snapshot, score is non-increasing in ascending rank, so ranking order is reproducible from the recorded score (ranking auditability).

scope_note: Replay is typed disposition replay over a fixed released claim set. It is not model-text determinism and not a full ranking re-execution claim.
